rationale: Ryan is building standardized infrastructure for physical capabilities across robotics and autonomous systems, while Kaushik brings hands-on robotics and embedded systems expertise with deep Python and C++ experience. Their complementary skills—Ryan's protocol design vision paired with Kaushik's practical robotics engineering background—could help bridge the gap between PCCP's infrastructure goals and real-world implementation challenges in autonomous systems.
intro_message: Ryan George, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both deep in robotics and autonomous systems, and Kaushik's hands-on embedded systems experience could be valuable as you build out PCCP's standardized protocol infrastructure.
